results.name: 12 Baskets Cafe
results.description: A community meal cafe run by the Asheville Poverty Initiative in West Asheville. A standing crew of volunteers serves meals on weekdays, with an optional monthly orientation for newcomers.
results.notes: Grey: volunteer program of a nonprofit. Kept per lenient rule; website inferred from contact email domain, not verified.

results.name: Alcoholics Anonymous Early Birds
results.description: An early-morning Alcoholics Anonymous meeting held in the library of a Flat Rock church. Peer support for people recovering from alcohol addiction.
results.home_base: St. John in the Wilderness, Flat Rock
results.notes: 87 weekly events, recurring AA meeting in Henderson County. No dedicated site found.

results.name: Asheville AI Safety
results.description: A group that hosts free, beginner-friendly talks and discussions about advanced AI and its risks to society. No technical background needed.
results.notes: Only 3 events, last in April 2026. Small but a returning discussion group.

results.name: Asheville Beer Choir
results.description: A casual sing-along choir night where anyone can join in group songs over a beer. Meets monthly at Archetype Brewing.
results.notes: Six monthly events at Archetype; web search found no dedicated page.

results.name: Asheville Comedy Fans
results.description: A Meetup page that lists ticketed stand-up comedy shows at several Asheville venues.
results.notes: Listings are promoter shows (Modelface Comedy, Rooftop Comedy); no member group identity, only hosts recur.

results.name: Asheville Fika
results.description: A social group that meets at local cafes and bakeries for coffee and conversation, in the Swedish fika tradition. Meets at a different cafe each time.
results.notes: 82 events, last Sept 30; regular social coffee group.

results.name: Asheville Japanese Language Meetup
results.description: A conversation group for speaking Japanese, welcoming learners of all levels and native speakers. Meets at a cafe inside Whole Foods.
results.home_base: Whole Foods Market, Tunnel Rd, Asheville
results.notes: 41 events through September 2026.

results.name: Asheville on Bikes
results.description: A nonprofit bicycle advocacy organization with members and volunteers. It runs a weekly social community ride and events such as Ride of Silence and Pumpkin Pedaller.
results.notes: Own site confirmed in input. Advocacy org plus weekly ride; Dirt Skrrts is a separate group.

results.name: Asheville Short Story Club
results.description: A book-club style group that reads one short story per meeting and discusses it over drinks. Meets at taverns and cideries on the east side of Asheville.
results.notes: 10 events with a different story each time.

results.name: Asheville Tech Events
results.description: A community of developers, data professionals and tech hobbyists. Hosts casual socials, co-working days and civic tech projects like Code with Asheville.
results.notes: 66 events; umbrella for Coders League, Code with Asheville, GDG etc.

results.name: Astrology Club
results.description: A drop-in astrology discussion group at the Weaverville Community Center for chart talk, questions and shared learning.
results.notes: Distinct from m:asheville-astrology-club (Asheville Meetup); different town and host.

results.name: Beer City Bears
results.description: A social group for bears, cubs, chubs and their admirers in Asheville's LGBTQ+ community. Hosts monthly bar socials listed through Blue Ridge Pride.
results.notes: Eight monthly socials through Aug 2026; website is Blue Ridge Pride, not the group's own page.

results.name: Blue Ridge Dirt Skrrts
results.description: A women's nonprofit offering no-drop mountain bike rides for all abilities, beginner to expert. Rides are followed by a social hangout.
results.notes: Search confirms nonprofit since 2021 for women's off-road riding; own site not found.

results.name: Center for Spiritual Living Asheville
results.description: A spiritual community teaching Science of Mind, with Sunday celebrations and groups such as a Course in Miracles study group and racial healing conversations.
results.notes: Congregation with member programs. Own site not verified.

results.name: Cork & Craft
results.description: A Meetup page for ticketed paint-and-sip classes at breweries and bottle shops.
results.notes: Paid guided painting classes by one instructor; storefront for classes.

results.name: Django Jazz Jam at Sovereign Kava
results.description: A monthly gypsy jazz jam inspired by Django Reinhardt's Hot Club style, held at a kava bar. Open to players and listeners.
results.notes: Grey, kept per lenient rule. Recurring jam with players; last seen May 2026. May overlap c:django-jazz-jam-with-fatty, left separate.

results.name: Enjoy Your Life Asheville
results.description: A social group for sports fans and party events, including a Michigan sports watch club and community service projects.
results.notes: Seven events, last Feb 2026; organizer-led social group with charity element. Weak but kept.

results.name: Friendly People in Asheville
results.description: A social group for adults in their 20s, 30s and 40s that organizes scavenger hunts, movie nights, live music outings and discussions to help people meet friends.
results.notes: 35 events through Oct 2026.

results.name: Happy Hour Horticulture
results.description: A monthly gathering for plant lovers to chat about growing, swap cuttings and trade local tips over drinks.
results.notes: Grey: only Explore Asheville listings; unclear if a host venue promotion. Kept per lenient rule.

results.name: Hookr's Night
results.description: A fiber crafts meetup for knitters, crocheters and other fiber crafters. Bring a project and chat at a Fairview brewery.
results.notes: Description confirms open fiber craft meetup, no sign-up. Hosted by brewery.

results.name: Jack's Old-Time Jam
results.description: A long-running weekly old-time Appalachian music jam where local musicians gather to play at a downtown pub.
results.home_base: Jack of the Wood Pub, downtown Asheville
results.notes: 50 events; musicians return weekly.

results.name: Laughing Heart Sangha
results.description: A Buddhist-inspired sangha that meets for a dharma teaching, 20 minutes of meditation and group discussion. No charge.
results.notes: 39 events through Sept 29, 2026.

results.name: Magnetic Minds
results.description: A free, peer-led weekly support group for people living with depression, bipolar disorder and related mental health challenges.
results.notes: Mountain Xpress listings confirm; last event Feb 2026.

results.name: Meeting of Masters
results.description: A monthly lightworker support circle for readers, healers and spiritual guides to share experiences and connect, held at the Black Mountain library.
results.notes: Only two events; search found nothing more. Possibly related to m:asheville-lightworkers-collaborative but unconfirmed.

results.name: Modern Mystic Collective
results.description: A monthly in-person circle for connection and inner work, blending earth-based traditions, practical magic and manifestation. Donation based.
results.home_base: Raven and Crone, Merrimon Ave, Asheville
results.notes: Two events so far; donation circle with regulars.

results.name: NiDaDa
results.description: A home sanctuary in Asheville hosting circles such as a Death Cafe and a dream-sharing group, plus occasional house concerts.
results.notes: Grey: mixes venue and groups; Death Cafe and dream group are recurring circles. Last event July 2026.

results.name: Open Hearted Christians & Deep Conversations
results.description: A progressive Christian community that gathers for conversation, dinners and service activities such as canvassing.
results.notes: Bi-weekly gatherings from June to Sept 2026; newer group.

results.name: Postpartum AVL Support Group
results.description: A free postpartum support group for mothers of babies up to 12 months, with free drop-in childcare. Held at the Asheville YMCA with Postpartum AVL.
results.notes: Confirmed on ymcawnc.org listings; input cadence suggests biweekly, search says third Friday.

results.name: Retired Dudes Coffee Club
results.description: A coffee club for retired men to meet, swap ideas about retirement and support a local cafe.
results.home_base: Green Sage Cafe, Merrimon Ave, Asheville
results.notes: New group with two meetups in Sept 2026.

results.name: Shamanic Ceremony with Shaun Meraya
results.description: Paid shamanic ceremony evenings led by one practitioner on the Blue Ridge Parkway.
results.notes: Single practitioner selling ticketed ceremonies and a paid membership; no member-run community.

results.name: Solo Agers
results.description: A peer support and friendship group for older adults who are aging without close family nearby. Meets at the AmeriHealth Caritas Wellness Center.
results.home_base: AmeriHealth Caritas Wellness Center, Asheland Ave
results.notes: Seven recurring Eventbrite listings; sponsored by an insurer's wellness center, but a standing peer group.

results.name: StrathSpan
results.description: A Celtic music trio based in Asheville and Black Mountain that hosts a monthly fiddle-led Celtic session with friends and fellow players.
results.notes: Band of regulars with own site; last session April 2026.

results.name: The Asheville Babes
results.description: A women's social group that meets for walk-and-talks, Pilates and themed get-togethers to build friendships.
results.notes: Six events March to Sept 2026.

results.name: Third Place AVL
results.description: A social group for people in their 20s, 30s and 40s with small-table events like supper clubs, pickleball, trivia and pre-show drinks.
results.notes: New group (Sept 2026) with six upcoming events. Distinct from Friendly People in Asheville.

results.name: Urban Sketchers Asheville
results.description: The Asheville chapter of Urban Sketchers, artists who sketch on location. It co-hosts the Carolinas Sketch Crawl with the Charlotte and Greenville chapters.
results.notes: Local chapter of a global community; only the June 2026 crawl is in the data. Own chapter page not confirmed.

results.name: Well Played Magic: The Gathering Meetup
results.description: A weekly casual Magic: The Gathering night with loaner decks and game masters to help newcomers learn. Held at Well Played board game cafe.
results.home_base: Well Played Board Game Cafe, Asheville
results.notes: 43 events; regulars return weekly, though venue-hosted.

results.name: WNC Longevity Meetup
results.description: A group that hosts evidence-based talks and discussions on healthy aging, such as brain aging and its risk factors.
results.notes: Only one event, March 2026. Grey, kept per lenient rule.

results.name: Women Who Run With the Wolves Ceremonial Book Club
results.description: A women's book club reading Women Who Run With the Wolves through storytelling, ritual circle and discussion, led by Magi Caswell of Coven Divine.
results.notes: Grey: ticketed and practitioner-led, but a returning cohort reading a book together. Kept per lenient rule.
